title: Implementation evaluation with interrupted time series and control charts
purpose: Evaluates change after an AI implementation using segmented regression, run charts, control limits, uptake, and balancing measures.
input: `TimeSeries` sheet with date, outcome, implementation_flag, uptake, and balancing_measure.
outputs: Segmented-regression coefficients, observed and fitted trends, control chart, pre/post summary, uptake chart, and implementation interpretation.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
